requirements.title: CFI_is_contiguous has the ISO_Fortran_binding.h contiguity-query interface
requirements.definition: CFI_is_contiguous has the interface int CFI_is_contiguous(const CFI_cdesc_t *dv) and tests contiguity of an array.

pending.CFI_is_contiguous-interface: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declares a const CFI_cdesc_t pointer, and compiles an ordinary CFI_is_contiguous call returning int.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future mixed Fortran/C fixtures compile a C companion with the processor ISO_Fortran_binding.h, link it with a Fortran driver through the existing C interoperability harness, and assert only portable descriptor members, pointer equality or address differences computed from descriptor storage strides, CFI_SUCCESS equal to zero, named CFI error macros by identity rather than numeric value, and exact integer/logical status results. Numeric values of error macros other than CFI_SUCCESS, C object padding, alignment choices beyond successful creation, allocation addresses, and selection among several detected errors remain processor latitude.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Caller shall-restrictions are source-control restrictions and are not promoted to diagnostic facets. Error-preservation facets lacking a portable conforming way to force a detected error remain pending with a no-portable-oracle reason.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: existing source-form, type, kind, declaration, expression, assignment, execution, allocation, pointer, array, derived-type, interoperability, and Clause 16 intrinsic-module foundations where already catalogued. Unregistered dependencies retained: sibling Clause 18 descriptor object, descriptor member, ISO_Fortran_binding.h macro, type-code, attribute-code, and error-code sections, C companion compilation support, and C standard alignment, offsetof, pointer, and object-representation terminology reached by future fixtures.

requirements.title: CFI_is_contiguous argument must describe an array with nonnull base address
requirements.definition: The argument shall be the address of a C descriptor describing an array, and the descriptor base_addr member shall not be a null pointer.

pending.CFI_is_contiguous-array-descriptor: Positive companion establishes a rank-two int array descriptor before the query; scalar descriptor mutation is a nonconforming source-control negative without required diagnosis.
pending.CFI_is_contiguous-base-address-nonnull: Positive companion uses nonnull local storage; null-base descriptor mutation is nonconforming and is not a portable diagnostic oracle.

requirements.title: CFI_is_contiguous returns 1 for contiguous arrays and 0 otherwise
requirements.definition: The result is 1 for a contiguous array described by dv and 0 for a noncontiguous array.

pending.CFI_is_contiguous-contiguous-result-one: C companion establishes a rank-two descriptor over contiguous int storage with extents 3 and 4 and asserts CFI_is_contiguous returns exactly 1.
pending.CFI_is_contiguous-noncontiguous-result-z: The same companion creates a rank-two section with lower {0,0}, upper {2,3}, and strides {2,1}; it verifies selected element values differ from the full array pattern and asserts CFI_is_contiguous on the section returns exactly 0.

accounting.rationale: NOTE summarizes contiguity for assumed-size and allocatable arrays and is not normative.

review_rationale: Source registration for 18.5.5 and 18.5.5.1-18.5.5.9, the functions declared in ISO_Fortran_binding.h: CFI_address, CFI_allocate, CFI_deallocate, CFI_establish, CFI_is_contiguous, CFI_section, CFI_select_part and CFI_setpointer (batch244). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; success paths and isolated named-error conditions are planned as C companion programs with exact results. Source accounting only.
